title: Document the actual proxy result metadata in the API guide
prompt:
Change only src/app/docs/page.tsx among production files. Evidence: src/app/docs/page.tsx:250-253 publishes a successful proxy response with a top-level usage object. The implemented response at src/app/api/bazaar/proxy/route.ts:296-306 uses meta instead, including tool, provider, cost_cents, cost, latency_ms, and remaining_balance_cents. Rendering the documentation component and parsing its proxy response example confirmed usage exists and meta is absent. Developers following this example read an undefined field from successful calls.

Correct only the proxy success-response example to match the implemented envelope and SPEC.md SS1. Include all current metadata fields with consistent fictional values: for example, one cent costs $0.0100. Preserve the request example and other endpoint documentation. Do not alter proxy behavior or charging logic.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/docs-proxy-response-envelope.test.ts. Transpile and render the real documentation component with lightweight JSX stubs, locate the Endpoint element by its proxy path, and JSON-parse its response prop. Assert result and meta shapes, numeric metadata types, absence of usage, and the cost conversion. Compare the field set with the committed billing-envelope fixture/schema without making a tool call. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/docs-proxy-response-envelope.test.ts and node --test tests/mcp-billing-v1-conformance.test.mjs tests/spec-route.test.mjs. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
